simple.summary: גָּרָב (gârâb) means scurf (from itching) First listed occurrence: Deut 28 27.

definitions.full: H1618. garab גָּרָב noun [masculine] itch, scab (Arabic , Aramaic גַּרְבָּא , , Assyrian garabu Dl § 162 ) — גָּרָב Lev 21:20 ; 22:22 ; Deut 28:27 .
